extraction: DAG Orchestration benefits and when to use. Executes data processing pipeline as dependency graph: extract and config tasks run in parallel, transform waits for both, validate runs in parallel with results from transform. When to use: complex workflows with clear dependencies, parallelizable independent tasks, need for deterministic execution order. Benefits: explicit dependency management, parallelization, fault isolation, observability. Part of 6-part taxonomy of 30+ patterns: Core Patterns (1-10), Quality & Oversight (11-13), Pipelines & Cost (14-18), Multi-Agent Collaboration (19-26), Reasoning Patterns (27-30), Domain Applications (31-34). Related patterns: Plan-and-Execute (17), Cascading Agents (18), Generator-Verifier (11), Agent-as-a-Judge (12), Human-in-the-Loop (13), Map-Reduce Agents (14), Mixture-of-Agents (15), Debate/Adversarial (22), Red-Team Agent (23). Mini-project example: DAG Data Pipeline.
